title: Senior Asset Operation Specialist
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Overview

This role sits within the Asset Operations team and is responsible for the full lifecycle management of the platform's digital assets — spanning new asset onboarding, post-listing maintenance, liquidity and risk monitoring, yield optimisation, and asset value management. Through cross-functional collaboration with Wallet, Security, Finance, Compliance, and Marketing teams, the role ensures assets operate securely, generate stable returns, and maintain strong platform visibility.

Key Responsibilities

1. Asset Onboarding & Maintenance

  • Lead the evaluation, testing, and launch of new tokens and chain assets, including mainnet deployment, parameter configuration, fee adjustments, and network verification
  • Continuously monitor asset performance and coordinate with Wallet, Security, and Finance teams to ensure fund security, sufficient positions, and stable operations

2. Post-Listing Asset Operations

  • Manage ongoing operations and maintenance of listed assets, including contract upgrades, token rebranding, asset repricing, and announcement publishing
  • Track ecosystem developments (mainnet upgrades, contract migrations, etc.), assess their potential impact on the platform, and develop response strategies

3. Risk Events & Incident Response

  • Monitor, flag, and rapidly respond to asset-related risk events including network anomalies, price irregularities, contract issues, and position gaps
  • Coordinate across Wallet, Security, and Finance teams to execute risk isolation and loss mitigation measures
  • Lead post-incident reviews and process improvements; maintain and enhance emergency response mechanisms and SOPs

4. Process Management & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Develop and maintain SOPs covering asset onboarding, maintenance, upgrades, and risk handling to improve overall execution efficiency
  • Coordinate with Wallet, Security, Finance, Compliance, and Marketing teams to ensure project timelines and launch schedules are met
  • Provide regular reporting on asset operations metrics and project progress; drive continuous process optimisation

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above; background in Finance, Economics, Blockchain, or related fields preferred; familiarity with traditional securities or relevant financial certifications is a plus
  • 2+ years of experience in crypto asset operations or project management; solid understanding of major public chains, stablecoins, and RWA
  • Deep understanding of user behaviour, marketing dynamics, and asset value logic within the crypto industry
  • Familiarity with digital asset regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to independently analyse and report on key metrics such as trading volume, AUM, and yield
  • Strong cross-functional communication and coordination skills; proven ability to drive collaboration across technical, security, and finance teams
  • Fluent in both Chinese and English (spoken and written); able to conduct professional communication with overseas project teams
  • Resilient under pressure with strong problem-solving ability; genuine long-term passion and conviction for the crypto industry

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
